data.name: The Mother of Echoes
data.description:
The four shards are her invitation. Carry one of each (Keel, Crown, Tide and Ledger) to the Mother Glass under Crownhold; all four are spent when the fight begins.

Three battles, one after another. Health, chakra and stamina carry from each battle to the next, with no refills. Lose any battle and the attempt ends; the shards are not returned.

Watch the floor. Every mark she draws is a warning, and every warning comes due.

If you still have a reward to choose from an earlier attempt, claim it before you start.
data.successDescription: The Mother Glass cracks from the root to the crown. Choose your reward.

objectives.description:
The four shards fit together in your hands, and the seams vanish. They were never broken. They were an invitation.

They pull you down, past where Crownhold's stair ends, into a hall of glass. Every pane holds a face. The Deck Warden. The Captain, twice: once bareheaded, once crowned. The guards you cut down. Their eyes are open, and none of them blink.

She hangs in the air before the Mother Glass, her fan open behind her like a halo.

"Lovely, aren't they? Every one of them held still for me." She smiles at the faces. "The ship, the castle, all of it. I never lost them. I kept them." She inclines her head, as if you had asked. "Sayo. I grew the glass."

"And you have been cutting them out of my glass, one by one. How interesting."

She studies you the way she studied them. "There is room in the glass for one more."

She turns to the wall, as if choosing a place for you. Her shadow does not turn with her. It stays where it was. Then it stands up off the floor.
Act I: The Glasswright and the Deep

objectives.description: The deep goes quiet, but the glass does not. Sayo wipes a line of light from her sleeve. "You read patterns well. Let us see how well you remember them."

objectives.description: Every pane in the hall turns toward you. The dark at the edge of the light folds itself small and slides back across the floor into Sayo's shadow. Her eyes close. When she speaks again, nothing moves her lips. "Hold still. You will make for a good impression."

objectives.description:
The Mother Glass cracks from the root to the crown. For the first time since the siege, Crownhold makes a sound.

You are not stilled.
The glass keeps what it was given. Find four more shards and come back.
